style="">Issue:</b> The current system processes XML files from the connection flow and moves them from the SFTP read folder to the processed folder. However, while there is a configuration in place to check and process only files with permitted content, all files, regardless of content validity, are moved from the read to the processed folder after processing.</font></div></blockquote><div style="font-size: 26px;"><font face="Courier New" style="font-size: 26px;"><br></font></div><div style="font-size: 26px;"><font face="Courier New" style="font-size: 26px;"><br></font></div><blockquote style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 40px; border: none; padding: 0px; font-size: 26px;"><div style=""><font face="Courier New" style="font-size: 26px;"><b style="">Changes for Version 1: </b>We plan to implement a mechanism that will pass the file paths along with the processed files in a sequential manner. This will ensure that during the export to the final connector, only those files that have passed validation checks are transferred.</font></div></blockquote>" div.span:
Files that are present to the SFTP server are now directly getting read all at once using loop for each customer and getting stored inside the runtime memory in the form of list of string.
Now here in the list, the entire file content is getting read line by line and getting converted into single string and then getting appended to the list.
So If there are five files on SFTP server then there would be a list getting created which will have Five string, each string representing the entire content of the file.
